# Course fonts (vendored)

Atkinson Hyperlegible, Barlow Semi Condensed and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts, Latin + Latin Extended subsets
only, as woff2 (`courses.css` points at them). SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-*.txt`). Downloaded by
`python3 tools/build_courses.py --fonts` (which also writes `SHA256SUMS`), so the courses work offline and never
contact Google.
